ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all incorporators, directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against the HM Treasury Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, and Bermuda Sanctions Regulations. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and their close associates are subject to enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, and senior-management approval. Definitions and escalating review procedures follow the Bermuda AML/ATF Code of Practice 2020 and Financial Action Task Force Recommendations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies e-Services portal (Companies eRegistry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Proposed company names must be in English using Latin-script characters; non-Latin script names require a certified transliteration into English. Names must end with a mandatory suffix such as 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' for an exempted company, and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing Bermuda company, foreign company, or reserved name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 calendar days of a written rejection, the applicant may submit an administrative appeal for reconsideration to the Registrar of Companies via the Companies eServices portal. If the administrative refusal is upheld, the applicant may file a fresh name reservation, and if the decision still remains adverse, judicial review may be pursued before the Supreme Court of Bermuda. No statutory extension letter beyond the initial 30-day reservation is generally available.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may be used for correspondence and administrative mail handling, but it does not satisfy the statutory registered office requirement. The exempted company must maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda with a licensed resident agent or service provider. For a non-licensed video-matching application, the physical registered office remains mandatory; a virtual mailing address can be supplementary but never a substitute.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate for an ordinary exempted company with no Bermuda-situs employees or regulated financial activities, estimated at 10-20% in the first year of operation. The likelihood increases to 25-40% if Bermuda Monetary Authority or the Registrar identifies enhanced AML risk factors, receives a suspicious activity report, or if the company pivots into payment processing or digital-currency-related activity.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 1981 of Bermuda (as amended), Part II (Exempted Companies), ss. 4 (exempted status), 5 (powers), 7 (memorandum), 78-81 (registered office, minutes, registers); supplemented by the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2016 and the Annual Returns Act 1975.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Corporate Registry, Government of Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and the Certificate of Incorporation (issued by the Registrar); supporting Form 1 (Application for Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account required. Authorized share capital may be set as low as US$12,000 without incurring stepped concessionary fees. Share consideration must be determined by the Board and may be satisfied in cash or in kind.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the subscribers to the Memorandum of Association of the Company do hereby take up the initial subscribed shares and agree to pay the subscription consideration in accordance with the Bye-laws. (2) That the registered office of the Company be established at [registered office address], Pembroke, Bermuda, and that a licensed corporate services provider be appointed as registered office agent for service of process. (3) That [Name] be appointed sole Director, [Name] President, and [Name] Secretary, each to serve until removed or superseded by the Board. (4) That the Directors are authorized to execute all statutory filings, open bank and EMI accounts, and take all steps required to obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and maintain ongoing compliance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Corporate Registry (online e-services portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request with up to three proposed names (primary and two alternates). The Registrar will reject names identical or confusingly similar to existing Bermudian entities. Restricted words (Bank, Insurance, Trust, Royal, Reinsurance) require the prior written consent of the relevant Bermuda regulator. Reservation is valid for a limited period, typically 28 days.
required_dossiers: Copy of passport and proof of address of each subscriber
Letter of consent from the relevant regulator if a restricted word is used
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refused on similarity or objectionable grounds, file a fresh application with an alternate name within 5 business days; no penalty and no processing fee forfeiture.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Bermuda corporate services provider (acting as agent for the subscribers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association incorporating the exempted-company declaration under s.4 of the Companies Act 1981, together with the Bye-laws (adopting or disapplying the Table of Regulations). Each subscriber executes the Memorandum in the presence of a witness. Notarization is not mandatory but is commonly required by Bermuda banks and EMI payment partners.
required_dossiers: Consent to act of first director
Subscriber due diligence pack (passport, utility bill, source of funds statement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition on form or content, file revised constitutional pages with re-executed signatures within 14 days of the requisition date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Corporate Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 1 (Application for Incorporation), the executed Memorandum of Association, the first director's consent, and evidence of payment of the government registration fee of USD 1,715 (authorized capital up to USD 12,000). Payment is made online via the Corporate Registry portal or by bank draft payable to the Accountant-General of Bermuda.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond in writing to the Registrar's requisition within 14 days, attaching a corrected Form 1 or amended constitutional documents; the application will resume processing upon cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Corporate Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and registers the company on the Bermuda Register of Companies. The company then acquires separate legal personality and limited liability. Immediately thereafter, the registered agent must file the beneficial ownership particulars under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2016.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains clerical errors, file a written rectification request with the Registrar; corrected Certificate is issued within 5 business days at no additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Office and Resident Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered office provider on the roll of the Registrar of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Board appoints a licensed registered office provider and a resident secretary. The registered office must be a physical street address in Bermuda, open during statutory business hours for receipt of process. The resident secretary must be an individual or licensed corporate services entity as prescribed by law.
required_dossiers: Agency agreement with the licensed provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office provider resigns, file a Notice of Change of Registered Office with the Registrar within 30 days; failure to do so may result in administrative striking-off.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory On-Boarding and Compliance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies; Bermuda Monetary Authority (AML supervisor for financial licensees); Office of the Privacy Commissioner (data protection)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the company's annual return within 30 days of the anniversary of incorporation under the Annual Returns Act 1975; maintain the statutory registers (members, directors, charges); complete AML/ATF registration if the entity carries on financial or ancillary activity; assess whether Privacy Act 2016 registration applies for processing of Bermuda personal data in the video-matching platform.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing of the annual return attracts a fixed civil penalty (approximately BD$288); file the overdue return and a curing declaration within 14 days to avoid a striking-off notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - no industrial or manufacturing operations; digital services liaison via the Bermuda Business Development Agency (BDA) and the Registrar of Companies
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Exempt - no sectoral operating or manufacturing permit required for ISIC 6311 digital platform services; non-binding registration with the Office of the Privacy Commissioner under the Privacy Act 2016 may be required for handling Bermuda personal data

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Ministry of Home Affairs, Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - the activity is a non-physical digital service with no listed development under the Schedule of Developments; no EIA registration or full EIA Report is mandated
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable - no wastewater, VOC, or industrial waste generation occurs. If a physical office lease is later established, comply with the Clean Air Act 1991 and Water Resources Act 1991 for any incidental sanitary discharges, and the Waste Management Regulations for disposal of electronic equipment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office-only clearance: Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service fire safety certificate for leased premises; Department of Planning use-class consent for office use; and compliance with the Occupational Safety and Health Act 1982, including a workplace risk assessment and employer's liability insurance. No plant, heavy machinery, or structural load certification is applicable.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Office of the Tax Commissioner (Revenue Portal, Government of Bermuda); Registrar of Companies (corporate registry administered by the Bermuda Registrar of Companies)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity seeking to operate through a Bermuda Exempted Company incorporates under the Companies Act 1981 through a licensed local registered agent. The incorporation process yields a Certificate of Incorporation and, upon filing of the exempted materials, an annual Certificate of Exemption identifying the entity as a Bermuda exempted company. No statutory income tax ID or VAT ID is issued because Bermuda levies no corporate income tax and no VAT. For any Bermuda-source payroll activity, the entity must separately register with the Payroll Tax Office for a payroll tax account only if it has Bermuda-based employees; for a pure foreign-owned video-match social app with no Bermuda payroll, no payroll-tax registration is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966, an exempted company may obtain a Government undertaking that no future taxes on profits, capital gains, distributions or income will apply until 31 March 2035, and that no estate, inheritance, succession or gift tax will apply. There is no Bermuda 'check-the-box' election. For U.S. federal tax purposes the Bermuda exempted company is a foreign eligible entity and may file IRS Form 8832 to elect classification as a disregarded entity or association taxable as a corporation, subject to Treasury regulations; hybrid mismatch elections are irrelevant to Bermuda direct tax because Bermuda imposes no income tax.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT / GST / Sales and Use Tax (Bermuda has no general indirect tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable; no indirect tax registration obligation exists for Bermuda exempted companies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable; Bermuda does not require e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, real-time reporting, API clearance, or digital stamping for exempted companies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. Bermuda does not impose any VAT or goods and services tax on exports or on any supply, whether domestic or offshore. Consequently, there is no export zero-rating mechanism to claim and no input VAT refund system exists for Bermuda exempted companies.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable - no export VAT zero-rating regime exists
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Not applicable for export zero-rating because no such VAT relief is granted. General penalties under Bermudian corporate law apply for false declarations made to the Registrar or Tax Commissioner, including monetary fines and potential loss of exemption status under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act; no retrospective tax clawback is relevant absent any indirect tax.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1:1 to the US dollar (USD) and is fully convertible in law and market practice. Bermuda maintains a residual Exchange Control Act regime administered by the BMA, but Bermuda exempted companies (BM_EXEMPTED_CO) are typically designated as 'non-resident' for exchange control purposes, thereby enjoying unimpeded current account and capital account convertibility, including unrestricted opening of foreign currency bank accounts, retention and deployment of export proceeds, and dividend/profit remittance to shareholders, provided the company's business is conducted wholly outside Bermuda and the requisite 'non-resident' designation is endorsed by the BMA. Profit remittance operates via the provisions of the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1973; no material exchange control hurdles are expected for the described corporate structure. The BMA maintains jurisdiction over balance-of-payments reporting and foreign currency transaction monitoring, but does not impose approval hurdles for non-resident exempted companies making legitimate distribution remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For a non-resident Bermuda exempted company, no export proceeds surrender requirement exists under the Exchange Control Act 1972, the Exchange Control Regulations 1973 or the Central Bank of Bermuda Act 1969. The obligor has zero mandatory conversion ratio and no statutory deadline for converting export receipts into BMD. This exempted treatment is predicated on the BMA's designation of the company as non-resident; should the company conduct local business within Bermuda (which this entity does not), a conversion obligation would apply within 28 days and 100% of export receipts would need to be surrendered through an authorised dealer. For the present scope, all export proceeds may be retained, deployed and invested in USD, BMD or other permitted foreign currencies without surrender.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW / RESTRICTED. Bermuda's Payment Systems (Electronic Payments) Act 2019 obliges any electronic money institution or payment service provider operating in Bermuda to obtain a licence from the BMA. A non-resident exempted company may not lawfully maintain a virtual EMI account offshore unless the EMI is a BMA-licensed enterprise or operates under a recognised passporting framework; however, UK/EU EMIs commonly reject Bermuda-licensed corporate clients due to enhanced correspondent banking de-risking and evolving high-risk jurisdiction classification nuances. Digital cross-border EMIs such as Wise (UK) or Revolut Business generally require a physical underlying bank settlement; given the BMA licensing requirement and the electronic-money-issuer-of-record controls, the practical viability of offshore EMI accounts is low. Direct account relationships with the four Bermuda commercial banks constitute the most reliable route. A hybrid approach of using an EU/UK EMI as a disbursement tool with a Bermuda operational account as the anchor is legally permissible provided the EMI does not maintain a branch, market into Bermuda, or solicit Bermudian residents.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors are required to complete a face-to-face or notarised-certified KYC interview for initial account opening with a Bermuda-licensed bank. Physical attendance of all directors and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) at a Bermuda branch or an accepted embassy/notary office is normally mandatory for the Tier 1 banks, unless the bank accepts a 'reliable independent verifier' certificate under the Proceeds of Crime Regulations 1997 and the Financial Intelligence (Bermuda) Regulations 2021. Remote video KYC is admissible for ongoing due-diligence renewals, but initial onboarding requires a secure video plus a notarised identity instrument or certified hard-copy passports, proof of source of funds, and a corporate register extract. The Bermuda law imposes independent verification of identity wherever the client is not physically present; a two-factor biometric verification and an attorney/solicitor certification satisfying the reliable independent verifier test are the only waivers to the physical mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk industry classification: real-time video matching and random social telephony (ISIC 6311 / NAICS 519130) — the account is perceived as carrying micro-transaction money-laundering and fraud risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documentation bundle required: (a) an independently prepared enhanced due-diligence narrative; (b) the company's written AML/KYC policy with automated transaction monitoring programme; (c) a forensic privacy and data-protection policy; (d) a signed declaration of no inception of peer-to-peer money transfer; (e) a third-party audit opinion on the payment routing infrastructure (Apple IAP / Paymentwall) confirming that only app-store aggregated collections and licensed merchant settlement rails are used; (f) a source-of-funds register evidencing venture capital or founding shareholders' banking references.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident exempted company with offshore directors and shareholders — banks may apply a low/medium residual risk rating and demand enhanced CDD.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documentation bundle required: (a) notarised certified copies of valid board and director identity credentials; (b) a certificate of good standing from the Bermuda Registrar of Companies; (c) an organisational chart of UBOs, including the legal chain of ownership; (d) banking references from each UBO's home regulated bank; (e) an attorney-in-fact or tax opinion confirming non-resident exchange-control classification; (f) the annual return of directors and shareholders filed with the Registrar.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Prohibited/QR currency flow alarm — random-video-chat applications often trigger elevated risk of virtual cash collection or unlicensed remittance; AML screening by SWIFT correspondent banks may fail due to missing BMA payment-services licensing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documentation bundle required: (a) a notarised legal opinion that no in-app wallet storage, no peer-to-peer exchange, no fiat-to-crypto conversion and no pre-funded virtual wallet liability is created; (b) a contractual exhibit from Apple (IAP) and Paymentwall evidencing that the platform acts solely as a billing aggregator subject to merchant-of-record arrangements and not as an agent under Bermuda's Electronic Payments Act; (c) a day-level reconciliation of historical settlement and underlying customer transaction records; (d) transaction staying/suspicion reporting policies aligned to FIAU and BMA reportable thresholds; (e) a copy of the registered intermediary or merchant agreement with the payment rails.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Single-jurisdiction cash concentration — a dormant operational account with active cross-border disbursements and no local trading footprint may be flagged for trade-based laundering or proliferation risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documentation bundle required: (a) a treasury structure chart showing dedicated inbound capital account, operational disbursement account, and segregating escrow or reserve account; (b) audited financial statements for the operating period or interim management accounts if newly incorporated; (c) a cash-flow forecast and projected budget showing operational purpose; (d) board resolutions authorising account signatories and the treasury policy; (e) an anti-trade-based-laundering control declaration evidencing inspection of underlying sales and marketing vendor contracts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing should be structured as: (1) a SWIFT MT103 originating from the shareholder's bank to the Bermudian operational account; payment must be denominated in USD or BMD and must be split between a capital contribution for equity or a shareholder loan for treasury funding; (2) the remittance advice must state the standard purpose code applicable to foreign direct investment into Bermuda, namely IMF Balance of Payments Manual 7 (BPM7) category Other Equity — for non-FDI inward investment use Other Investment Liability — Currency and Deposits; (3) for equity injections in an exempted company the authorised share capital mechanics under the Companies Act 1981 (as amended) require issuance of shares and filing of a Memorandum of Increase of Authorised Share Capital if the cap is exceeded; (4) the bank will require a copy of the board resolution approving the capital call and share allotment, a structure chart showing the beneficial owner, and the bank's own Capital/Equity Investment questionnaire; (5) all verification documentation must be transmitted in advance of the wire under the bank's pre-approval regime; for amounts above $100,000 the mandatory reporting threshold to the BMA under the Financial Intelligence (Bermuda) Regulations 2021 is notification rather than consent, but any remittance above $6 million will trigger the BMA's Foreign Currency and Deposit Reporting requirements to the central bank within 48 hours.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Preferred clearing rails for trade settlements: (1) SWIFT MT103 for high-value or USD disbursements to merchant partners (Paymentwall, Apple) and content-distribution networks, using the priority field 'profit remittance' or 'business service fee'; (2) Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) when the trade settlement involves confirmed service-level agreements with counterparties requiring documentary security; however, for pure digital media services the LC route is inefficient and the standard operational rail is an MT101/MT103 chain executed by the Bermudian treasury. For operational transparency, the entity should maintain separate sub-ledger automation tracks for Apple IAP settlement (Payout/IOF) and Paymentwall payout; both tracks must settle to the Bermudian operational account with record-level reconciliation mapping to the monthly settlement statement. Wire transfers to low-tax or offshore prepaid-card providers are discouraged; SWIFT USD correspondent routing via the New York fed account of a Bermuda commercial bank is the compliant corridor. If payment is made to a BVI or Cayman counterparty, enhanced KYC evidence and beneficial-ownership indicia must be regenerated at each transaction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/BMD outright forward contracts with Bermuda-licensed authorised dealers and/or international banks
Cross-currency FX swaps for short-term funding requirements (BMD/USD)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for speculative offset hedging against multi-currency settlement (EUR/GBP) where physical delivery is impaired by BMD convertibility
FX options (vanilla European-style) for contingent trade exposure on Apple IAP settlement cycles
Cash-settled embedded FX swaps in a net settlement clearing arrangement with the Paymentwall merchant account

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form C) and Annual Company Fee Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due each calendar year on the anniversary of incorporation; return and fee must be received within 30 days after that anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts an escalating penalty of BMD 100–BMD 500; failure to file within six months may trigger a newspaper strike-off notice under s.238 of the Companies Act 1981, and directors become liable to fines up to BMD 1,000.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Beneficial Ownership Unit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the Annual Return (anniversary + 30 days). Any shareholding transfer requires an update to the Beneficial Ownership Register within 14 days of the transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance is an offence with fines up to BMD 10,000 and daily default penalties; continued non-compliance can be treated as grounds for administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies / Bermuda Tax Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of the financial year (standard December 31 year-end: due by June 30).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file an Economic Substance Declaration attracts a BMD 10,000 penalty plus BMD 1,000 per day of continued default, and may lead to strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Every Bermuda exempted company must appoint an independent auditor unless, being a private non-licensed company, all shareholders unanimously waive the audit requirement and the company has no public-traded securities. Mandatory audit applies to public companies, licensed insurance/banking entities, and any company that has issued securities to the public.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory Bermuda GAAP; accounts must present a true and fair view. IFRS is the standard default for exempted companies; US GAAP is also accepted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain a signed confirmation from the ultimate beneficial owner(s) each year at the time of the Annual Return. Share transfers require Register of Members and Beneficial Ownership Register updates within 14 days; the Annual Return includes an attestation that the statutory registers and the beneficial ownership register are accurate and up-to-date.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 2,200 – USD 4,500 per year for registered office and corporate secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,500 – USD 9,000 per year if an audit is required; USD 0 – USD 2,000 for a preparation of management accounts and waiver documentation

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (nil) for ordinary Bermuda Exempted Companies; 15% CIT only for in-scope MNE groups under the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Exempted Companies hold a statutory tax exemption certificate under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 guaranteeing no income, capital, or withholding taxes until at least 2035; no VAT, payroll tax, or wealth tax applies. In-scope MNE groups may claim the substance-based income exclusion and transitional credits against the 15% CIT.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda CIT Return (Form CIT-1) filed via the Bermuda Tax Administration (BTA) e-filing portal at portal.taxauthority.bm
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return is due within 15 months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year constituent entity, the deadline is March 31 of the second following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification: legal name, Bermuda Registry Number (BRN), registered office, and appointed tax representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the registered agent's Bermuda address as service address; state the jurisdiction of tax residence and disclose the non-resident beneficial ownership schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: MNE group scope determination: consolidated group revenue exceeding EUR 750 million and designation as Constituent Entity, Ultimate Parent Entity, or Joint Venture.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the group's org chart and GloBE jurisdictional operating units; identify the UPE jurisdiction for GloBE information return purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda qualifying jurisdictional return status: QDMTT, IIR, or UTPR election and local safe harbor calculations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include the election form for QDMTT safe harbor; non-resident entities must demonstrate the economic substance basis for standalone calculations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: GloBE income or loss and covered taxes; includes deferred tax adjustments and tax expense allocation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile the Bermuda statutory accounts to GloBE tax base; attach transfer pricing schedules where transactions cross borders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Substance-based income exclusion: payroll and tangible asset carve-outs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide Bermuda payroll records and local asset registers; assignment of remote employees to other jurisdictions must be documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Effective top-up tax computation: jurisdictional effective tax rate and top-up tax payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply qualified domestic minimum top-up tax credits and attach the computation workbook.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late CIT return filing incurs a fixed penalty of BMD 10,000 plus BMD 250 per day, capped at BMD 25,000; failure to pay triggers interest at 8% per annum, enforced collection, and potential prosecution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Economic Substance Declaration (ESR return) filed online through the Registry General eServices system (www.registrar.gov.bm).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the end of the relevant financial year; for a December 31 accounting period, due June 30 of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Relevant activity classification: IP business, headquarters, distribution and service centre, financing, holding business, etc.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A video match social app with proprietary algorithms and licensing revenue must classify as an IP business; describe the contractual source of IP income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income derived from the relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate revenues by geographic source and cross-border counterparty; attach a revenue breakdown by payment rail (Apple IAP, Paymentwall).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Core income-generating activities (CIGA): management, IP exploitation, risk assumption, and strategic decision-making.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State where board meetings are held, the physical presence of key decision-makers, and the location of servers and software development.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Employees and physical premises: full-time staff, officers, offices, and equipment in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide employment contracts and lease agreements; remote or gig-economy workers do not count unless legally employed in Bermuda.
Disclose third-party providers performing development, hosting, payment processing, or legal functions; demonstrate adequate monitoring and board-level oversight.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or meet economic substance obligations draws a BMD 10,000 fixed penalty plus BMD 100 per day of continued default; deliberate non-compliance can result in additional penalties, strike-off, and reporting to foreign tax authorities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Exempted Company Annual Return filed with the Registrar of Companies through the Registry General online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after each anniversary of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, exempted company number, and principal business activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the non-resident shareholding percentage and the registered agent's address as the Bermuda service address.
Must be a physical Bermuda address maintained by a licensed corporate services provider.
List all foreign directors and their service addresses; note visa or work permit status if resident in Bermuda.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital and shareholder distribution.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the register of members with classes of shares and nominee ownership declarations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a default fee of BMD 500; continued default exposes the company to striking-off, revocation of the exemption certificate, and restoration court orders.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Bermuda does not impose any withholding tax on dividends paid by a Bermuda Exempted Company to shareholders, whether resident or non-resident.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Bermuda has no comprehensive double taxation agreement with the United Kingdom or any other major trading jurisdiction. There is no treaty withholding rate to invoke. Investors seeking foreign tax credits in their own residence country must obtain a Bermuda tax status certificate from the BTA or the Registrar of Companies confirming zero tax incidence; a Tax Information Exchange Agreement request may also be made. The practical protocol is: (1) confirm exempt status under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act; (2) obtain a certificate of residence or tax status letter; (3) present that certificate to the foreign tax authority together with dividend distribution resolutions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Bermuda rate: 0% for cross-border IP royalties and debt interest. Treaty rate: not applicable (no DTA network). Payments made from a Bermuda exempted company are made with no withholding, but the payee must consider source, CFC, and permanent establishment rules in its own jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: BMD 0 for ordinary exempted companies (no Bermuda TP filing requirement). For in-scope MNE groups under the CIT Act, mandatory Bermuda Local File and Master File documentation applies when the group consolidated revenue is at least EUR 750 million (approximately BMD 750 million), with detailed records of cross-border related-party financing, IP licensing, and intercompany service charges.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Bermuda Economic Substance Act requires any exempted company carrying on a relevant activity to demonstrate economic presence proportionate to the business. ISIC 6311 (data hosting and online platform operations) is treated as an IP business when revenue is derived from proprietary video-matching algorithms, user data, or licensing arrangements. The company must show core income-generating activities in Bermuda: active board management, strategic decisions, adequate local employees, premises, and operating expenditure. Merely holding contracts and bookings outside Bermuda will fail the substance test and expose the entity to penalty and striking-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Misuse of Exempt Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Presenting a Bermuda Exempted Company as tax-free while the business is managed and controlled in the UK, earning UK-source revenues, or forming part of an MNE group that deliberately avoids registering under the Bermuda CIT Act 2023.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Bermuda Proceeds of Crime and tax legislation, the company is liable for underpaid tax (if in-scope) plus interest at 8% per annum and penalties up to 200% of the tax evaded; criminal conviction can yield fines up to BMD 100,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors are personally liable for civil restitution if they knowingly approve false returns; courts may issue travel bans, freezing orders, and disqualification orders, and in serious cases order imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a mere brass-plate company with no employees, premises, local board activity, or substantive management in Bermuda while booking video-app revenue and IP ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registrar may strike off the company, revoke its exempted certificate, and issue a penalty of BMD 10,000 plus BMD 100 per day for continued non-compliance; information is exchanged with foreign tax authorities under OECD TIEAs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certify false economic substance declarations face personal fines, disqualification from holding board positions in Bermuda, and civil restitution for funds mischaracterized as substance-based income.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML, Sanctions, and Payment Rail Integrity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing Apple IAP or Paymentwall transactions from global users without effective AML/KYC controls, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, or suspicious activity reporting, thereby facilitating money laundering, fraud, or terrorist financing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Bermuda's Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Code imposes entity-level fines, license revocation, and a criminal penalty of up to 14 years' imprisonment for money laundering; unlicensed money service business activity triggers separate penalties under the Banks and Trust Companies Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and senior managers are criminally liable if the company operates without appropriate AML systems; personal confiscation orders, asset forfeiture, travel restrictions, and debarment from regulated sectors apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing and UK CFC / GAAR Counteraction
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately shifting profits into the Bermuda exempted company through excessive royalties, intercompany service fees, or user data transactions without arm's length pricing, while the UK controller or HMRC regards the arrangement as abusive.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: HMRC can apply UK CFC rules to apportion profits to UK taxpayers at a 25% charge plus penalties of up to 200% of the additional tax; Bermuda authorities may also adjust CIT computations for in-scope MNE groups. Civil penalties and accelerated payment notices apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: UK-resident directors and shadow directors may incur personal liability under CFC attribution where they arrange a Bermuda structure for tax avoidance; HMRC can issue director penalty notices, travel bans, and proceedings for bankruptcy or imprisonment in cases of fraudulent evasion.
